purpose: Defines contextual project progress without stacking arbitrary percentage modifiers. Base RP represents inherent scientific/engineering workload; actual progress rate depends on one derived readiness score plus hard stage requirements.

base_project_work.meaning: Represents inherent scope/frontier difficulty before civilization-specific readiness.

stage_work.rule: Base project RP is divided across Experimental, Demonstrated, and Engineering stages using the current maturation seed shares.

hard_stage_gates: explicit Research Pressure gate where configured
explicit research facility capability required for the current stage
required physical sample/prototype/process where explicitly configured

field_competence.meaning: Stage-appropriate theory/experimental/engineering competence across the node's knowledge fields.

facility_readiness.meaning: How much assigned lab capacity is appropriately specialized/equipped once hard facility gates are satisfied.

evidence_readiness.meaning: Quality/relevance of observations, datasets, devices, samples, or test results when evidence materially constrains the project.

tacit_expertise.meaning: Practical expertise, protocols, operating institutions, tooling, and specialist knowledge when relevant.

component_applicability.rule: If a readiness component is genuinely not relevant to a project/stage, omit it and renormalize the remaining weights rather than inventing a hidden neutral bonus/penalty.
component_applicability.ordinary_domestic_example: An established domestic engineering extension may use field competence plus facility readiness and have no foreign/tacit evidence component.
component_applicability.foreign_device_example: Reverse engineering can use all four components because evidence and tacit expertise materially affect the work.

readiness_to_progress_efficiency.description: Severe competence/infrastructure gap; research is possible but highly exploratory/inefficient.
Competent but still learning substantially during the project.
Well-supported work at expected baseline efficiency.
Exceptional active competence/infrastructure; improvement is useful but deliberately bounded.

progress_formula.assigned_lab_rp_source: research_economy.json lab output and diminishing-return lab scaling
progress_formula.project_completion: stage completes when accumulated stage RP reaches its allocated share of base_project_work

special_cases.missing_hard_facility: Block the affected stage and explain what experimental/prototyping capability is missing. Do not convert impossibility into an enormous RP tax.
special_cases.missing_material_or_prototype: Project may pause/wait at the relevant stage. Economy/industry systems own the physical resource requirement.
special_cases.foreign_technology: Poor translation/compatibility/tacit expertise lowers readiness or blocks explicit stages; holding a device never becomes an automatic tech unlock.
special_cases.rebuilding_dormant_field: Surviving codified records raise competence floors/readiness, making restoration easier than first discovery even if active engineering practice atrophied.

anti_modifier_rules.bounded_exception: The final readiness efficiency curve is a single derived rate factor and is intentionally capped.
